_source: dennisonbertram/free-pi-cli src/update-check.ts (ClientVersionResponseSchema); values observed live on api.freepi.ai 2026-11-28
_note: GET https://api.freepi.ai/client-version is UNAUTHENTICATED and account-independent. `min` is a forced-update floor; `latest` is the newest PUBLISHED free-pi-cli release and is the ceiling for x-client-version — a number above it (such as 0.7) earns 426 upgrade_required. models[].id is the value a request must put in `model`.
